author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices finding E by the two black keys, echoing short tunes, waiting for a turn and playing together, with a rainy-day rhyme.

classes.title: Walk with Doctor Foster
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and walk your hands to its steady beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling footsteps that come evenly, one after another

classes.parentPrompt: Sit side by side and walk your fingers on your child's knee to the beat.
classes.childAction: Walk your hands on your knees, like the doctor going to town.
classes.bridge: Every beat is one of Doctor Foster's footsteps on the road.

intro.caption: Doctor Foster goes for a walk
intro.parentCue: walk your fingers on your knees to the beat.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling a steady walking beat.

classes.title: Tap the doctor's steps
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand on your child's hand; tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for each of the doctor's steps.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one footstep; one tap lands on each step.

intro.caption: One step, one tap
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder on each beat.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Find E, the puddle key
classes.goal: Find E by touching the two black keys, then sliding right.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two black keys help us find the same key every time

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger to touch two black keys, then slide right to E.
classes.childAction: Find the two black keys, slide right, and splash on E!
classes.bridge: E sits just right of the two black keys, like a puddle by two stones.

intro.caption: Let's find the puddle key
intro.parentCue: touch the two black keys together first.

games.caption: Splash, splash, splash on E
games.parentCue: Count the splashes together: one, two, three

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding E by the two black keys.

classes.title: Echo the doctor
classes.goal: Copy short patterns of two or three notes, right after the grown-up.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding a short tune in mind, then playing it back

classes.parentPrompt: Play a short pattern, then point to your child: your turn. Cheer every try.
classes.childAction: Listen to two or three notes, then play them back.
classes.bridge: An echo is a friend in a tunnel: you call, it calls back.

intro.caption: I call, you call back
intro.parentCue: play first, then point to your child.

games.caption: Walk to town: C, D, E
games.parentCue: Play it first, then point: your turn

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and playing short tunes back.

classes.title: Up the hill, down the hill
classes.goal: Echo three notes that climb up, then three notes that walk back down.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune climbs up, then walks back down the same way

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers up your child's arm, then down, as the notes go.
classes.childAction: Echo three notes up the hill, then three notes down.
classes.bridge: E, F, G climbs the steps to town; G, F, E walks back home.

intro.caption: Up the hill and down again
intro.parentCue: walk your fingers up and down the keys.

games.caption: Up the steps: E, F, G
games.parentCue: Point to each key as it lights

games.caption: Down the steps: G, F, E

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a tune go up, then down.

classes.title: Wait for the puddle!
classes.goal: Listen to the song and play E at the right moments.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your part is part of the music

classes.parentPrompt: Play the blue keys; nod to your child just before each E.
classes.childAction: Wait and listen, then splash on E when it's your turn.
classes.bridge: The tune walks along the road; E is the puddle you jump in.

intro.caption: Wait for the puddle
intro.parentCue: nod to your child just before each E.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for your turn, then playing.

classes.title: Walk to town together
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, the grown-up on the tune, the child on E.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keep the same beat, so the song stays together

classes.parentPrompt: Keep playing even if a note is missed; nod the beat with your head.
classes.childAction: Play your E's while your grown-up plays the rest.
classes.bridge: You and your grown-up walk side by side, step for step.

intro.caption: Let's play it together
intro.parentCue: keep going, even if a note is missed.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping one beat with two players.

classes.title: Rainy concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, from the first step to the last, then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: The song tells a little story: walk, rain, splash, home

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; make the puddle line splashy, then bow together.
classes.childAction: Play your E's to the very end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: Walk, rain, splash in the puddle, and never go there again!

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song story, start to end.
